description: Story chapter catalogue: ordering, presentation assets, DLC unlock flag, voice ids and the ordered list of demos belonging to each chapter.

ID.technical: FName row key in StoryChapterDataTables (DTM +0x8B0). Used as the progress-flag map key, in FindRow lookups by id, and returned by Story_GetChapterIdByIndex. Exported ids CHAP_0001..CHAP_0009.

ChapterIndex.technical: int32 (row +0x10), default 0 in the row constructor. Story_GetChapterIdByIndex scans for a match; Story_PickRoomPlacement picks the row with ChapterIndex == 6 as the checkpoint chapter; the chapter-select widgets pass it as the INDEX text parameter. Exported values are 1..9.

Id_StoryChapterTitle.simple: Localized-text id for the chapter name.
Id_StoryChapterTitle.technical: FName (row +0x14) passed straight to SetTextIdOnly / GameTextParameterMap_AddTextId in chapter select, mission select, character-select mission info, the system dialog and the shop sale-item description; no fallback text is produced by these consumers.

ThumbnailFileName.technical: FName; UGameStoryMissionSelectWidget creates WidgetTexture primary-asset loaders from ChapterRow->ThumbnailFileName for the chapter panel when its loaders are empty.

SmallThumbnailFileName.technical: FName (row +0x24); used as the WidgetTexture loader key for chapter-select content and DLC chapter-select content, and by UGameStoryWidget's thumbnail loader setup. The loaded texture is placed in the ReplacementTexture material parameter.

BackgroundMovieFileName.simple: Background movie name for the chapter menu.
BackgroundMovieFileName.technical: FName. UGameStoryWidget collects every non-None value into a map from Chapter.Id to <value>.usm and assigns it to Background->ChapterMovieFiles when changing the DLC background. Only two exported chapters set it.

Id_Bgm.technical: FName. MainMenuStory prepare resolves non-None values through BgmDataTables, stores the Bgm row id in ChapterBgmIds keyed by Chapter.Id and primes resume positions; chapters with None are skipped.

UserProgressFlag.simple: DLC/user-progress flag controlling chapter lock and store routing.
UserProgressFlag.technical: TArray<int32> (row +0x40), exported with one entry. -1 means no flag: MissionSelect_HasProgressFlag / Story_GetChapterFirstUserProgressFlag report no progress flag, so the chapter is treated as base story. A set flag is decoded as word = flag >> 2, bit = flag & 3 against UserProgressFlagWords[128]; MainMenuStory_IsChapterLocked checks that bit, and the DLC result flow maps the same flag to a store page. Story_GetProgressFlagChapters keeps chapters whose first flag is not -1.

Id_PlayVoice_OnOpenMissionSelect.simple: PlayVoice row used on mission-select entry.
Id_PlayVoice_OnOpenMissionSelect.technical: FName (row +0x50). BuildChapterVoicePicks resolves it to a PlayVoice row; RollChapterVoicePicks uses its Id_Voice and Weights_VoiceLottery arrays to roll a weighted PickIndex, with None names and paired weights removed first (PickIndex = -1 if either list ends empty).

Id_PlayVoice_OnSelectMission.simple: PlayVoice row used when a mission is chosen.
Id_PlayVoice_OnSelectMission.technical: FName (row +0x58). Story_GetChapterSelectVoiceType_1307CA0 resolves it to a PlayVoice row and returns PlayVoiceType, or 0xFF when the chapter/row is missing. UGameStoryMissionSelectWidget::OnMissionDecided plays that voice type with the rolled PickIndex when not 0xFF.

Id_PlayVoice_StartDialog.simple: PlayVoice row whose Id is sent to the story character-select phase.
Id_PlayVoice_StartDialog.technical: FName (row +0x60). BuildChapterVoicePicks stores the found PlayVoice row as SelectVoice; after a mission decision MainMenuStory copies SelectVoice->Id into GameManager.StudioStoryRequestName_CEC along with the chapter's PickIndex.

Id_StoryDemo.simple: Ordered StoryDemo ids in this chapter.
Id_StoryDemo.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x68), 20 slots in the export. Consumers iterate it for progress percentages, chapter lock/unstarted tests, resume-demo selection, available demo lists, room-condition selection and reverse lookup of a demo's chapter. Id suffix "M" marks main demos; CHAP_0007 is specially treated as all-main. Some helpers use GetData()[0] without a length check.

notes: Chapter 6 has special semantics in Story_PickRoomPlacement_13097C0: if any main demo there (or any demo in CHAP_0007) is uncleared, the last cleared demo's room condition is used; otherwise the saved placement may be kept or a uniform condition picked (Source/Abrams/Private/StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:230-290).
Row constructor sets only ChapterIndex to 0; FName and array members default empty (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_StoryChapter.cpp:3).

Nine exported rows; no numbered shards or locale variants were found. Some DLC-specific behavior in this area depends on the reconstructed GameDlcEntitlementTable and on partially available Content; no exhaustive retail/BP claim is made.
